script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

JANE (mid 30s, bookish, introverted) sits at a small table, engrossed in a novel. Her eyes dart up as the door swings open, revealing MAX (mid 30s, athletic, extroverted), clad in gym clothes, holding a to-go coffee. Jane looks away, embarrassed.

MAX (smiling)
Morning, Jane.

JANE
(quietly)
Max.

MAX
You're always so engrossed in your books. I bet it's a good one.

JANE
(smiling back)
It is.

MAX
(leaning against the table)
I wish I had the time to read more. You know, before my workouts.

They share a laugh.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

Jane finishes her book and gathers her things. Max approaches, holding out a new novel.

MAX
Another one?

JANE
(smiling)
I can't get enough.

MAX
(laughing)
You and your books.

JANE
(teasingly)
And you and your workouts.

They share another laugh.

EXT. PARK - AFTERNOON

Max and Jane sit on a bench, surrounded by blossoming flowers. They talk about their lives, their dreams, and their fears.

MAX
I've never seen you so open, Jane. It's really nice.

JANE
(blushing)
It's nice having someone to talk to.

Max looks at her, a deep affection in his eyes. He reaches out and takes her hand. They share a moment of quiet understanding.

INT. ART GALLERY - EVENING

Max leads Jane through the gallery, admiring the paintings. They come across a beautiful portrait of a woman, and Jane is captivated.

JANE
(whispering)
It's stunning.

MAX
(whispering back)
It reminds me of you.

JANE
(surprised)
Really?

Max takes Jane's hand and guides her to a quiet corner. He pulls out a small, worn notebook and begins to read a poem he wrote for her.

MAX
(reading)
In the quiet corners of my mind,
I find your face, a work of art divine.
Your gentle touch ignites my soul,
Bringing warmth to the coldest of holes.

JANE
(tearing up)
Max...

They share a tender kiss.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Max helps Jane into her apartment, and they sit on the couch, surrounded by her books. They talk about their future plans and dreams.

JANE
(whispering)
I've never felt so alive.

MAX
(whispering back)
I've never felt so at peace.

They share another kiss, their bodies entwined.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Six months later, Jane sits at her usual table, engrossed in a new novel. Max enters, holding two coffees and a small bouquet of flowers.

MAX
Morning, Jane.

JANE
(smiling)
Max.

They share a warm smile, their eyes filled with love.

MAX
You look beautiful.

JANE
(blushing)
You're just as handsome as ever.

They sit down, and Max leans in to steal a kiss.

FADE OUT.

THE END
